title: Create and Set Up a New Project
trigger: User wants to start a new project from scratch

steps.action: Click New Project in the Start section
The native folder picker opens to select where to create the new project folder
The new folder opens in the cluster with File Explorer showing empty or existing contents
If not yet initialized, Home shows an option to Set up as an OpenKaava project, or the button may auto-initialize it
After setup, Project.kaava manifest and .kaava/ directory appear in the project root

outcome: New folder is created as an OpenKaava project with manifest and .kaava/ directory
